result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with commercial land use and visible pedestrian signals. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and the wide roadway creates a long crossing distance for pedestrians without a refuge.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are heavily worn and difficult for drivers to see, reducing the visibility of the pedestrian crossing area.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection in the foreground and mid-ground.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the intersection corners may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street near the intersection corners.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with embedded trolley tracks and multiple travel lanes, creating a significant crossing distance for pedestrians. While sidewalks and faded zebra-style crosswalks are present, the environment is degraded by poor pavement quality and a lack of modern safety features like refuge islands or clear pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven surfaces around the embedded trolley tracks create tripping hazards for pedestrians and instability for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway and throughout the intersection area.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes and tracks without any mid-block refuge, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main thoroughfare at the foreground intersection.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing zebra markings are heavily worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised concrete island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Realignment
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility thermoplastic materials and ensure they are aligned with accessible curb ramps.

interventions.title: Pavement and Track Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair the degraded asphalt surrounding the trolley tracks to provide a smooth, level surface for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals despite being controlled by a traffic light. Large vehicles parked near the corner create significant visual obstructions, increasing the risk for people attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tow truck is parked very close to the intersection, blocking the view between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has traffic lights for vehicles but no visible walk/don't-walk signals for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and timing.
